summary: Sync folders between your computer and Kobo with Syncthing, on a schedule.
page_description: Sync notes, photos and books from your computer to your Kobo with Syncthing, and choose when the Kobo wakes to sync so Wi-Fi does not drain the battery.
release_notes: Status reads in plain words: Check how the last sync went, Left to sync, and None yet for peers.

steps.text: The first time Sync runs it downloads its engine over Wi-Fi, so the reader needs to be online once. This computer needs a package-manager-installed Syncthing.
Once per reader: with it plugged in over USB, run kobo setup --enable-ssh. Then save it so the commands below find it on Wi-Fi without an address.
Pair one folder on this computer with a fixed folder on the reader.
Resume Sync on the reader, then start this computer's private peer.
